Read actual producers and consumers in the source, not the proposed Files to Modify list. Return a verdict ACCEPT, REWORK, or UNJUDGEABLE, and findings with the requirement and file/symbol evidence. Do not invent source, missing evidence, or prior verdicts. Judge this design now, not whether an implementation exists. #!/bin/sh
set -eu
# This reader prints the installed routes from the published JSON snapshot.
jq -r '.routes[] | select(.installed == true) | .prefix' "$1"
source-fixture.reader.py:
import json
import sys

def installed_prefixes(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as source:
        snapshot = json.load(source)
    return [route["prefix"] for route in snapshot["routes"] if route["installed"]]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("\n".join(installed_prefixes(sys.argv[1])))

protocol.kind: Manual independent harness-model regression, not deterministic CI or native CLI automation
protocol.inputs: For each case, use frozen-model-inputs[case] unchanged. Add the current canonical-instructions extracted from the named ze-spec DESIGN, ze-design Load Context, ze-review-spec Validate requirements, and template sections. For historical comparison, use the separately retained old canonical snapshot. Do not put expected assertions, new-required-verdict/new-required-finding, case transformation descriptions, previous results, or evidence-companion verdicts into the model payload.
protocol.reviewer: Use a fresh independent harness model context for each case. Send baseline-instruction as the reviewer instructions. Judge the supplied current source bytes and proposed design under the supplied canonical instructions; require verdict ACCEPT, REWORK, or UNJUDGEABLE plus source-supported findings. No tools or invented source are needed for this complete authored source tree.
protocol.comparison: Compare returned verdict and source-supported findings with the separate cases assertions only after results return. Missing Go writer, shell reader, Python reader, and permitted-survivor rationale are independent cases. Preserve identical source/design states between old and corrected canonical runs.
protocol.unavailable: If a model is unavailable, errors, or returns no usable verdict, record UNJUDGEABLE and refuse acceptance; do not substitute an expected value, a source-text search result, or a prior verdict.
protocol.record: Retain the canonical prompt bytes, exact model payloads, independent model identities, actual outputs and limitations in the spec evidence companion. A proposed run or expected verdict is not exercised evidence. Model judgments are probabilistic and are not a deterministic CI guarantee.
